Audience: first-time Nevada Basic Class C applicants, especially those who will tow a travel, boat, utility or horse trailer within the Class C limit.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the chapter opens with the exact weight and length a Class C driver may tow [A01], and backing with a trailer reverses the steering habit of a car [A04].
Level: rule and term recall with a few exact limits and inspection intervals, plus procedural checklists; higher conceptual load for weight balance and rearward amplification.
Prerequisites: sec05 for stopping distance and sec06 for turning and backing basics.
